$Comment: Defense XP added to what clearing the Headless Horseman's graveyard pays (the
Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Clear table), on a server running MMO Skill Tree.
ContributesTo folds this roll into that table without touching its file, so the table's own pay
is tuned there alone. Requires takes this file out on a server without MMO Skill Tree, so the
table pays exactly what its own file says there; always write it with Min 1. A roll with no
Chance always pays, and Amount is XP before any boost. The dungeon pays the table in full on the
first clear each day and half on later ones, and that halving reaches this roll too.
Name: Mmo_Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Clear
